description: Ordered PvE growth levels: experience gates plus stat, equipment-slot and heal-point unlocks.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_PvEGrowth. Exported ids are the level numbers as strings, but consumers select rows by iterating PvEGrowthDataTables in order and comparing ExperienceThreshold, so the id is not read as data.

ExperienceThreshold.simple: Experience needed to reach this growth level.
ExperienceThreshold.technical: int32, default 0. GamePvE_GetGrowthRow walks rows in order and returns the last row whose ExperienceThreshold <= Experience, so the table must be sorted ascending. Player-card level helpers count rows whose threshold is <= the character's experience, and VsEnemy growth widgets use the difference between adjacent thresholds as NecessaryExperience and the threshold itself as a release check.

HitPointMaxRate.simple: Growth multiplier for maximum hit points.
HitPointMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. GamePvE_CalcHitPoint starts with this rate when a growth row exists, multiplies by the ally parameter (when supplied), then adds equipment/vow terms and floors the final HP at 1.0. It is not added to StatusSetup.Rates in the battle-entry code; HP is computed directly.

CursedEnergyExpAddRate.simple: Growth multiplier for cursed-energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExpAddRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. In PvE battle setup for player/partner slots, (rate - 1.0f) is added to StatusSetup.Rates.CursedEnergyExp on top of any ally-parameter contribution; Tag mode does the same. Growth UI widgets also compare adjacent rows to flag an increase.

CursedEnergyRecoverRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Added as (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.CursedEnergyRecover for player/partner entries; downstream recovery queries multiply the status/action rates.

GuardDurabilityMaxRate.simple: Growth multiplier for maximum guard durability.
GuardDurabilityMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Added as (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.GuardDurabilityMax for player/partner entries; the resulting rate is combined with the battle-team value in AGameCharacter::GetGuardDurabilityMaxRate.

DashGaugeMaxRate.simple: Growth multiplier for maximum dash gauge.
DashGaugeMaxRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Added as (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.DashGaugeMax for player/partner entries; dash gauge is clamped to Owner->GetDashGaugeMaxRate() times the dash-gauge base.

DamageRate.simple: Growth multiplier for sent attack damage.
DamageRate.technical: float, row ctor default 0.0f. Added as (rate - 1.0f) to StatusSetup.Rates.SendAttackDamage for player/partner entries; the character damage accessor multiplies this rate with team/action/status factors.

EquipmentSlotNumber.simple: Number of equipment slots unlocked at this growth level.
EquipmentSlotNumber.technical: int32, default 0. The VsEnemy equipment-settings widget assigns the current row's value as SlotCount and uses the difference from the previous row to add newly unlocked slots; growth UI compares adjacent rows to flag the increase.

HealPointNumber.simple: Number of heal points available at this growth level.
HealPointNumber.technical: int32, default 0. Interval PvE initializes PvESettings.HealPointNumbers[CharacterIndex] from the growth row (or 0 when no row); those values are displayed as character info Value30, decremented when heals are used and augmented by battle results. Growth UI shows the delta between adjacent levels as COUNT in its change text.

notes: The exported asset has 35 rows with FGameDataTableRow_PvEGrowth; the manager loads PvEGrowthDataTable into PvEGrowthDataTables (DTM+0x940). No localization variants or numbered shards were supplied.
Row order is significant: GamePvE_GetGrowthRow returns the last row whose ExperienceThreshold is <= the supplied experience and assumes ascending thresholds.
Several UI widgets index GetRows<PvEGrowth>() by level-1 and compare adjacent rows; those are VsEnemy menu widgets, not battle logic, but they are substantive consumers of this table.
Selection/calculation helpers are reconstructed with retail RVAs in comments (for example 0x1305350 and 0x13054c0); status/functions.json should be consulted for byte status. Content is partial.

usages.detail: GamePvE_GetGrowthRow maps accumulated experience to the last satisfied growth row.
GamePvE_CalcHitPoint uses Growth->HitPointMaxRate in maximum-HP calculation.
Applies growth rate fields to player/partner battle setup.
Copies HealPointNumber into per-character PvE settings.
Counts satisfied ExperienceThreshold rows for aggregate PvE level display.
Growth menu compares adjacent rows to display unlock deltas.
